Desc.AllPrograms: The 'All Programs' module of Tranal Uninstaller Pro shows every installed program, split into two default groups: 'New' and 'Other'. In the 'Details' view or through the context menu you can get extra information (links and properties) about these programs. This module's settings are located in the Options menu.
Desc.TracedPrograms: The 'Monitored Programs' module of Tranal Uninstaller Pro lets you trace program installations. Every program installed with tracing produces a log with the files, folders and registry keys it created, which allows a precise uninstall.
Desc.WindowsApps: The 'Windows Apps' module of Tranal Uninstaller Pro lets you uninstall Windows Store applications installed for the current user.
Desc.BrowserExtensions: The 'Browser Extensions' module of Tranal Uninstaller Pro lets you remove extensions installed in the Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Opera browsers, including from the user profiles.
Desc.LogsDatabase: The 'Logs Database' of Tranal Uninstaller Pro keeps the logs of traced installations. Logs can be imported, exported and used to uninstall with precision.
Desc.HunterMode: The 'Hunter Mode' of Tranal Uninstaller Pro lets you uninstall programs from a desktop icon: drag the icon onto the Tranal window to uninstall the associated program.
Desc.AutorunManager: The 'Autorun Manager' of Tranal Uninstaller Pro manages the items that start automatically with Windows: Run registry keys, services, scheduled tasks and startup folders.
Desc.JunkCleaner: The 'Junk Files Cleaner' of Tranal Uninstaller Pro scans and removes temporary files, caches, logs and thumbnails that take up unnecessary disk space.
Desc.WindowsTools: The 'Windows Tools' of Tranal Uninstaller Pro give quick access to the native Windows utilities: disk cleanup, defragmentation, services, scheduled tasks, device manager and more.
Desc.HistoryCleaner: The 'History Cleaner' of Tranal Uninstaller Pro clears the run history, the clipboard, recent items and the search history.
Desc.EvidenceRemover: The 'Evidence Remover' of Tranal Uninstaller Pro removes traces of use: prefetch, Explorer history, jump lists, recent documents, event logs and the DNS cache.
Desc.UnrecoverableDelete: The 'Unrecoverable Delete' of Tranal Uninstaller Pro overwrites the content of the files before deleting them, so they cannot be recovered by data-recovery tools.
